briefdescription.para: Ablation study API for the layered hybrid retrieval architecture.

detaileddescription.para: Defines the typed contract for running and comparing ablation experiments across the ThemisDB retrieval stack. An ablation study systematically disables or varies one architectural layer at a time to quantify its contribution to overall retrieval quality.

listitem.para: Retrieval path — ANN-only vs ANN+Tensor vs ANN+Tensor+Graph.
Tensor freshness — fresh vs stale tensor summaries.
Update path — patch path vs full rebuild path.
Compute backend — CPU SIMD vs GPU refinement.

sect2.title: Error contract
sect2.para: AblationError is thrown when an experiment configuration is inconsistent, when the query batch is empty, or when metrics cannot be computed due to missing ground-truth data.

sect2.title: Thread safety
sect2.para: AblationRunner is NOT thread-safe. Experiments are registered and executed sequentially. Callers must synchronize externally when sharing a runner across threads.
